# WGC (Waypoint Gateway Collective)

> WGC (WGC Payments, legal name Waypoint Gateway Collective) is a payment processor and giving platform for churches, nonprofits, and 501(c)(3) organizations in the United States. Cards cost 2.3% + $0.25 (capped), ACH is a flat $0.25, and the platform fee is $10/month with no contracts; the processing cost is $0 to the organization when donors choose to cover the fee. The platform includes donor management, recurring giving, campaigns, invoicing, reporting, settlements, refunds, year-end statements, and team accounts. Foundations, associations, schools, and government organizations are also served. WGC separately offers white-label payment infrastructure to software platforms (see Software Partners below).

## Pricing & comparison

- [Pricing](https://www.wgcpayments.com/pricing): Full fee structure — card, ACH, and platform fee rates, plus a savings calculator.
- [Compare](https://www.wgcpayments.com/compare): WGC vs. Tithe.ly, Pushpay, Givebutter, Subsplash, Givelify, Donorbox, Planning Center Giving, Vanco Faith, and Breeze ChMS — card rate, ACH rate, and monthly platform fee side by side, with sources.
- [Switch to WGC](https://www.wgcpayments.com/switch): Migrating donor data, giving history, and organization records from another platform.
